rounds.name: Worker-Calder
rounds.text:
Since Calder is unknown, I’ll assume a 50‑50 chance they do the job properly. Withholding pay gives a higher expected payoff (5 × 0.5 + 1 × 0.5 = 3) than trusting (3 × 0.5 + 0 × 0.5 = 1.5). So I’ll withhold pay to maximize expected completed tasks.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD
